reason: My VA and I live in WhatsApp and the Sheet, and clients reach us there too, so moving our chat into a new app means two places to check, not one. The money is nothing, but dropping a client reply because the new app's notifications flaked costs me more than $20.
objection: A small startup's chat won't be as reliable as WhatsApp, and my assistant won't actually open another app every day.
would_change_my_mind: If it pulled our WhatsApp threads in and showed who last replied to each client, so we never had to leave WhatsApp to use it.
